svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 25 mm wide strip about 395 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the battery's front width (151 mm) in the middle and its depth

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (98 mm) each side of that, then a 20 mm foot on each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold 90 degrees at each mark so the strap fits round the battery's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front and sides and the feet turn outward against the gear plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill one 4.5 mm hole in the middle of each foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Line the inside with 2 mm closed-cell foam tape.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the battery stands on the box floor against the gear plate;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the strap goes round it 50 mm above the floor; M4 screws and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nyloc nuts through the gear plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the battery cannot move when you push it.
